name: John Aislabie

summary.text: John Aislabie was Chancellor of the Exchequer during the South Sea Bubble of 1720. The House of Commons Committee of Secrecy investigated him in 1721, and a Commons committee member reported an attempt by Aislabie's son-in-law Thomas Vernon MP to bribe him on Aislabie's behalf, for which Vernon was expelled from the House.

sources.title: The Parliamentary Diary of Sir Edward Knatchbull 1722-1730

facts.claim: Ross, a member of the Commons Secret Committee investigating the South Sea Bubble, reported that Thomas Vernon MP had attempted to bribe him to favour Vernon's father-in-law John Aislabie; Vernon was consequently expelled from the Commons.
